title: Improve quantized kernels: INT8/FP8 smoothquant + dequant fusion path
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: This PR improves the quantized inference kernel paths for INT8 and FP8 models by adding a fused smoothquant->dequant execution path, optimizing kernel packing for continuous batching, and introducing a scheduling hint so the runtime colocates dequant operations with attention kernels. Motivation: production workloads show suboptimal throughput for mixed-precision models due to repeated dequant/requant transitions and non-ideal memory layout for batched KV cache usage. Changes here reduce host-device transfers and increase SIMD-friendly memory layouts which yields lower tail latency and higher throughput. The description below summarizes the changes, testing, and benchmark results.
commits: a1b2c3d: add fused smoothquant->dequant kernel and registration plumbing
d4e5f6a: change kernel pack layout for quantized attention state (KV cache)
b7c8d9e: scheduler hint to colocate dequant with attention forward
f0e1d2c: add microbench harness and perf regression tests
review_comments: Miguel Santos: Can you explain correctness proof for fused path when scale maps are non-uniform across heads? Please add a unit test covering heteroskedastic per-head scales.
Aisha Kapoor: Added an additional unit test 'quant_fusion_per_head_scale' and a careful reorder that preserves per-head scale semantics. See tests/integration/quant_regression_test.py.
Riley Chen: Observability: please emit a metric when the fused path is used so we can monitor adoption and fallback frequency.
Aisha Kapoor: Instrumented runtime/metrics to emit 'quant.fusion_path.used=1' and added CI assertion in perf harness to check metric presence during runs.
Sofia Martinez: Nit: pack_layout.h public API should document alignment constraints for AVX512 vs CUDA tensor cores.
Aisha Kapoor: Expanded docs and header comments to call out alignment constraints and provide a fallback path for older SIMD targets.
release_notes: Reduced quantized INT8/FP8 inference CPU+GPU token cost by up to 18% on medium-length prompts via fused smoothquant->dequant path and improved KV cache packing. No behavioral changes to model outputs; added observability metric quant.fusion_path.used.
benchmarks: Microbenchmarks (internal perf lab) on p4d and a100 nodes: INT8 end-to-end throughput +12-18% (depending on sequence length). FP8 models +8-11% throughput. 95th percentile latency improved 9-14% for batch sizes 1-8. Memory footprint for KV cache reduced ~6% due to packed layout. Regression harness shows numeric difference <1e-5 compared to baseline dequant/requant with deterministic rounding and per-head scale preserved.
testing: CI: linux-build (pass), unit (pass), integration (pass), perf-harness (pass after rerun), lint (pass). One perf job initially failed due to missing CPU alignment on workstation runner; fixed by adding a fallback code path and rerunning. All tests green at merge.
motivation: Production customer SUP-4321 reported high tail latency for mixed-precision models. Investigation (ENG-9876) showed frequent dequant/requant thrash and suboptimal KV layout under continuous batching. This PR targets those hotspots with minimal surface area changes.
notes_for_ops: Enable metric 'quant.fusion_path.used' in dashboards and add alert if fusion path usage drops suddenly or CPU fallback rate exceeds 10%. New kernel requires no model changes but nodes with very old AVX support will fall back to legacy path; ops rollout verified with canary on Dedicated cluster.
